views.label: Empty bucket
views.note: create_bucket takes no provider and no terms. The caller becomes sole admin.

views.label: New bucket with primary
views.note: Terms with BucketTarget::New create the bucket and its first primary in one call.

views.label: Primary on existing bucket
views.note: Only a bucket admin can redeem primary terms for BucketTarget::Existing(id).

views.label: Replica on existing bucket
views.note: Any account the replica provider quoted as terms.owner can redeem.

messages.label: POST /negotiate: owner, bucket: null, max_bytes, duration, nonce
AgreementTerms (BucketTarget::New) + provider_signatures
messages.note: no price, no version in the quote

messages.label: hold AgreementPayment at the provider's current price
POST /negotiate: owner, bucket: id, max_bytes, duration, nonce
hold AgreementPayment at the provider's current price
POST /negotiate: owner, bucket: id, max_bytes, duration, nonce, replica_params

cards.title: Who may call
items: create_bucket: anyone; the caller becomes sole admin
create_bucket_with_primary: terms.owner; creates the bucket with min_providers = 1
add_replica_provider: terms.owner, any account the provider quoted

cards.title: Shared checks on signed terms
items: terms.bucket matches the call (TermsBucketMismatch); terms.owner matches the origin (TermsOwnerMismatch)
sigs (ProviderSignatures) over blake2_256(context | genesis_hash | SCALE(terms)): one entry for a physical provider, at least k members for a virtual one
terms.nonce equals AgreementNonces[owner]; redemption advances it. On NonceMismatch the client reads it again and requests a new quote
Term pinning: expected_version equals the provider's version (ProviderVersionMismatch). The quote contains no price and no version

Provider registered with stake >= MinProviderStake (StakeBelowMinimum), duration within its bounds, terms.max_bytes > 0 (InvalidMaxBytesRequest) and within capacity (CapacityExceeded). No stake-per-byte check

cards.title: Role-specific checks and what is written
items: Primary: replica_params = None, ProviderNotAcceptingPrimary, MaxPrimarySlotsExceeded (a virtual provider takes one slot per member)
Held payment: provider.settings.price_per_byte * terms.max_bytes * terms.duration, price read from ProviderInfo at redemption, prepaid
StorageAgreement gets a per-bucket agreement_id and snapshots provider.stake; a replica also snapshots replica_sync_price as sync_price
